llm.summary: This documentation-only skill coherently stores and searches PR review knowledge, with privacy and retention considerations users should manage before use.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to capture and retrieve PR-review findings in project memory palaces, and the artifacts consistently describe storing architectural decisions, patterns, standards, lessons, PR context, participants, tags, and related links for later search.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The workflow includes automatic capture after a PR review and proactive resurfacing during related work, but this is disclosed and limited to review knowledge rather than unrelated files, credentials, or external accounts.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains only Markdown skill documentation and referenced Markdown modules; metadata lists related OpenClaw/Night Market configurations but no executable install scripts, hidden hooks, or package-install commands.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Access to PR review content, project palace entries, indexes, and search/export commands is proportionate to a review-memory skill; no artifact evidence shows exfiltration, destructive actions, credential use, or unrelated environment access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill explicitly aims to create persistent searchable institutional memory and may retain participant names, security decisions, discussion context, indexes, embeddings, and caches; retention, deletion, and redaction controls are not fully specified.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only where the team is comfortable retaining PR review discussions in project memory. Avoid capturing secrets, private personnel details, or sensitive security discussion verbatim, and define retention, deletion, and export rules before enabling automatic capture.
llm.findings: [SQP-2] expected: The persistence of PR review content and participant information is real, but it is central to the skill's stated purpose and is repeatedly described as persistent searchable memory; this supports user caution rather than a Review verdict.
